_comment: Each tag is a yes/no question Jev answers about every email. An email gets the tag when the probability is at or above the threshold. Edit here or in the dashboard Tags page.

tags.name: Surcharging
tags.description: The email is about credit card surcharging: surcharge rates, enablement, eligibility rules, or the Sola Terminal surcharge release.

tags.name: Chargebacks
tags.description: The email is about chargebacks, disputes, or the RCVR chargeback management integration.

tags.name: Partner / Customer
tags.description: An external partner, ISO, merchant, or vendor is asking for something or reporting a problem.

tags.name: Jira / Dev updates
tags.description: An automated Jira, GitHub, or development tracker notification about a ticket, story, or build.

tags.name: Meeting / Scheduling
tags.description: Scheduling, rescheduling, accepting, or preparing for a meeting or call.

tags.name: Access / Credentials
tags.description: Requests for access, API keys, sandbox credentials, passwords, or account permissions.

tags.name: Security / Quarantine
tags.description: Security alerts, quarantine reports, phishing warnings, or token expiry notices.

tags.name: Product feedback
tags.description: A merchant, partner, or colleague is giving feedback or making a feature request about a product.
